pages.text: IridescentCraft adds $(bold)24 custom enchantments$(/bold) beyond the Apotheosis and vanilla pools. These are registered as real enchantments and work with all Apotheosis systems (affix reforging, gem sockets, etc.).$(br2)The enchantments are organized into five thematic groups.

pages.title: Dimensional Survival
pages.text: $(bold)Heatward$(/bold) — Fire/lava resistance scaling with level$(br)$(bold)Voidward$(/bold) — Void damage reduction$(br)$(bold)Depthstrider$(/bold) — Pressure/depth damage resistance$(br)$(bold)Aether Acclimation$(/bold) — Cold/height environment resistance$(br)$(bold)Warp Shield$(/bold) — Teleportation effect resistance$(br2)$(italic)These are essential for Tier 3+ dimensional content.$(/italic)

pages.title: Resource & Combat Enchants
pages.text: $(bold)Prospector$(/bold) — Passive ore detection$(br)$(bold)Lumberjack$(/bold) — Tree-felling radius$(br)$(bold)Reaping$(/bold) — Auto-replant on harvest$(br2)$(bold)Momentum$(/bold) — Movement-speed-scales damage$(br)$(bold)Adrenaline$(/bold) — Low-HP damage boost$(br)$(bold)Titan Slayer$(/bold) — Bonus damage to large/boss mobs$(br)$(bold)Crowd Control$(/bold) — AoE slow/weaken on hit$(br)$(bold)Adaptive$(/bold) — Resistance to most-recently-received damage type
